description: Bus Guides for Metro stations is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. This dataset provides Bus Guides for 13 Metro Stations along the Sydney Metro North West Line, including 8 new metro stations along the Chatswood to Sydenham extension due to commence August 2024. Each guide displays a table with all the Bus routes including the destination description and stand section and a Bus Map. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are Bus Guides, Bus Map, Bus Routes, Chatswood to Sydenham, M1. It offers 44 resource(s) in 2024, PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
